description: Defines the TracingDispatcher class responsible for managing tracing operations within the Playwright core server, including starting, stopping, grouping, and chunking trace data.

classes.name: TracingDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for handling tracing operations, extending the generic Dispatcher with Tracing, channels.TracingChannel, and context dispatchers.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing TracingDispatcher for a given scope and tracing object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new TracingDispatcher instance with a scope and tracing object.

methods.name: tracingStart
methods.description: Starts tracing with specified parameters and marks the dispatcher as started.

methods.name: tracingStartChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk and returns the result.

methods.name: tracingGroup
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group with a name and location.

methods.name: tracingStopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk and returns the artifact and entries.

methods.name: tracingStop
methods.description: Stops tracing and marks the dispatcher as not started.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the dispatcher is disposed, stopping any ongoing trace chunks.
